name: Collector 2: Electric Boogaloo
teaser: Adds a new collection quest to Fence after the completion of Collector, Lightkeepers & Ref's questlines.
description_html:
Should be compatible with any 3.9.x version in theory, only personally verified on 3.9.4 and 3.9.5

Quest Prerequisites:

Fence: Collector

Lightkeeper (though Ragman has the final part): Overseas Trust - Part Two

Ref/Fence: Decisions, Decisions (Or Between Two Fires)

Mod Dependencies:

Virtual’s Custom Quest Loader

Ref - SPT Friendly Quests

Items to Find (not handover):

Armband (RFArmy)

Armband (Rivals 2020)

Armband (Kiba Arms)

Armband (Train Hard)

Armband (DEADSKUL)

Armband (Labs)

Armband (ARENA)

Armband (Evasion)

Armband (UNTAR)

Armband (TerraGroup)

Items to handover:

Rusted Bloody Key

Advanced Current Converter

Silicon Optoelectronic Integrated Circuits textbook

Advanced Electronic Materials textbook

TerraGroup “Blue Folder” Materials

Cultist Knife

Crash Axe

Red Rebel

Taiga 1

Miller M2 Tactical Sword

SP-8

SOG Voodoo Axe

Kollontays Baton

APOK Gladius (not found in raid)

Reward:

There is a config to change various elements of the quest reward (item & Inventory size, weight & disabling of filters)

This was my first foray into SPT modding, if you have any suggestions / improvements I would be open to hear them. Thank you!

Known issues:

May run into issues with the icon overhanging the item in the stash if you set the item size to smaller than the icon (Weapon case size - 5x2)

Future Plans:

Potentially a new custom model
